description: Text and bytes that the parser or the canonicalizer must reject before any hash is computed. The hash of invalid content is undefined and never published. raw_text holds JSON text. bytes_hex holds bytes that are not valid UTF-8.

records.note: A parsed object repeats one key. Two readers could keep different members, so no hash is defined.
The number 1e400 parses to a value that is not finite. Numbers must be finite before canonicalization.
A string holds an unpaired surrogate code point. Canonical UTF-8 text cannot carry it.
The bytes c3 28 are not valid UTF-8.
